scripts.emulators:start: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT='60'; if (!(Test-Path '.output/server/index.mjs')) { npm run build; if ($LastExitCode -ne 0) { exit $LastExitCode } }; if (!(Test-Path '.output/server/node_modules/firebase-functions/package.json')) { cd .output/server; npm install --omit=dev; if ($LastExitCode -ne 0) { exit $LastExitCode }; cd ../.. }; npx firebase-tools emulators:start --project majstorsada-b2ad4 --only auth,firestore,functions,storage"
